title: Python: Variables
description: Write a Python program that declares variables of different types and prints them.

codeTemplate.py:
name = "Python"
age = 33
pi = 3.14159
is_fun = True

print(f"Name: {name}")
print(f"Age: {age}")
print(f"Pi: {pi}")
print(f"Is fun: {is_fun}")

verificationTest: output.includes('Name: Python') && output.includes('Age: 33') && output.includes('Pi: 3.14159') && output.includes('Is fun: True')
hints: Python is dynamically typed — no type declaration needed
Common types: str, int, float, bool
